subject: gk
question:
Read the statements below about the 38th National Games:

Statement 1: The 38th National Games were hosted in Uttarakhand.

Statement 2: It was the first time the National Games were organized across several cities within the state.

Choose the correct option.

options.text: Both Statement 1 and Statement 2 are correct
Neither Statement 1 nor Statement 2 is correct

solution:
The correct answer is** Both Statement 1 and Statement 2 are correct**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The 38th National Games were hosted in **Uttarakhand**, making Statement 1 correct.
 
• **Statement 2 is correct**, as the 38th National Games marked the first time the event was organized across multiple cities within a single state.
 
• Uttarakhan
